verdict.rationale: Turso documents Embedded Replicas, which keep a local read replica of a cloud database: reads are served locally and writes go to the cloud primary, then flow back to the replica. The durability page also gives an eleven-nines durability figure. However, the pack contains no documentation of high availability, failover behavior, replica promotion, or server-side regional read replicas, so only the read-replica half of the story is evidenced. missing for 10: documented HA architecture, failover/primary-promotion behavior, server-side or multi-region read replicas, uptime/availability SLA, independent corroboration of failover.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can add read replicas and rely on documented high-availability and failover behavior

citations.quote: Embedded Replicas keep a local read replica of a Turso Cloud database: reads run locally from the file in microseconds, and writes are sent to the cloud primary and then reflected back to the replica.
providing local-first writes, explicit `push()` / `pull()`, and significantly less bandwidth and lower latency
